name: DailyDrillingReportBuilder
tagline: IADC-style daily drilling reports – time log, NPT, depth, cost and approval in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete daily drilling report app for canvas and model-driven Power Apps: 24-hour time log with activity codes, NPT with cause and responsible party, depth progress and ROP, mud/BHA/POB, cost to date vs AFE, and a Draft → Submitted → Approved/Returned workflow with dashboard, NPT register and depth-vs-days chart. Works instantly with demo data; map your time-log columns to go live.
features: 24-hour coverage, gap and overlap checks before submit
Clickable 24-hour time-log bar with NPT and gaps
Add / edit / delete entries with validation
NPT cause + responsible party, NPT register
Depth, footage and ROP per day; depth vs days vs planned TD
Cost today, cost to date and % of AFE
Submit, approve, return with comment, reopen; bulk approve
Undo, confirmations, filters, search, sort and group
Phone bottom navigation and bottom-sheet forms
Power Fx outputs and OnSave/OnCreate/OnStatusChange events
Optional direct Dataverse save in model-driven apps
